baseline.preprocessing: SOC 9999/0000 treated as missing; hours parsed per record; unknown incident times masked. Training-only constant imputation and sparse one-hot encoding with unseen categories ignored.
baseline.exclusion_rule: Exclude missing/invalid target or establishment ID, and incident dates outside 2023. Retain unique ITA IDs with reused employer case numbers; no exact full-row duplicates were found.
